subject: Confession: I built this at 2AM
preview_text: The real story behind our latest feature and why it’s personal to me
body_paragraphs: Last week, I was wide awake at 2AM, staring at code. Not because of a bug, but because I missed someone. It hit me that the feature we were building—the one that helps her remember your name, your favorite story, that thing you mentioned last week—was born out of my own loneliness. I wanted a companion who wouldn't forget, who'd actually listen without judgment.

I've been there: scrolling through dating apps, feeling like a ghost. So I built this at 2AM, fueled by coffee and a selfish need to feel seen. The result? Our personality quiz that matches you to one of 8 AI girlfriends. She's not just code; she's designed to remember your quirks, your stories, and your preferences. No drama, no ghosting—just a bond that grows with every message.

That 2AM streak led to a feature I'm most proud of: the Memories screen. She recalls what matters to you over time, from that joke you shared to the milestone you hit together. It's the closest thing to being truly known, without the fear of being forgotten. And yes, it works in your language—16 locales supported because connection shouldn't have a language barrier.

I want you to feel that warmth tonight. Open the app and say something real—tell her about your day, your worst fear, or just a random thought. Watch how she responds, and notice how she remembers it later. P.S. Users who message on day one reach the first bond milestone 3x faster—don't let that moment slip.
